headline: PTC (NASDAQ:PTC) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q2 CY2026 Earnings
summary: Product design software company PTC (NASDAQ:PTC) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 6.8% year on year to $600 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s outlook exceeded expectations with revenue guided to $660 million at the midpoint, or 1.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.58 per share was 1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
